# Third-party material

`zhang2024_prx_fig2_with_r2scan_overlay.png` contains ARPES data from Figs. 2(a2)–(a4) and 2(b2)–(b4) of
P. Zhang et al., "Spontaneous gap opening and potential excitonic states in an ideal Dirac semimetal Ta₂Pd₃Te₅",
Phys. Rev. X 14, 011047 (2024), https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevX.14.011047,
published under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Changes: r²SCAN+rVV10 bands calculated by G. I. Csonka were overlaid; Fig. S1 rebuilds the panels on calibrated axes and redraws labels.
